known_limitations: Reported qber_interval is a conservative hull of CP, 1-s-block bootstrap, run bootstrap and paper-estimator +/-1.96 SE. CP alone is too narrow: the runs are overdispersed (chi2/dof ~10).

Runs linear/06 and diagonal/05 show residual median offsets of +0.74/-0.79 ns, fewer pairs and higher QBER (1.70%, 3.64%). Likely imperfect alignment in the authors' processing. They are kept, not cut.
Raw pipeline omits the authors' per-client-detector delay shift and drops multi-occupied bins deterministically, which explains the 5.3% pair-set difference.
TTM8000 tick 82.3045 ps is taken from the authors' script and not checked against device documentation.
match_window greedy resolution is a Python loop: fine for ~1e6 candidates, slow for much more.
